cost_registry_line: CM-PILOT-BYVGENF32-2026-001 step 2 (canonicalised targets): the Medumba generalisation recipe with float32 master adapters and ORIGINAL (NFC) targets: the same-image baseline for the NFD arm, and a descriptive reading of the precision fix on unseen voices/sentences. 3,000-step LoRA from base on byvgen1 (2,895 Medumba training clips). Worst case $2.67 on-demand (6,000 s), below the $10 calibration tier; expected ~$2.0. Step 2 = two trainings + two 1,346-row decodes ($0.40 worst each) = $6.13 worst case against the $6.40 cap. Diagnostic only - nothing may be promoted, registered or served.

data_version_pins.split_rule: sha256('byv-genz-2026/'+speaker_id) ascending, first 15 speakers held out (unchanged from byvgen1)
data_version_pins.why: MEDZEN_MANIFEST_VERSION names a version; it does not pin its CONTENT. The launcher verifies these against live S3.

managed_spot_reason: account spot quota for ml.g6.xlarge is 0; on-demand ceiling keeps worst case below the $10 calibration tier
worst_case_basis: 6,000 s ceiling on ml.g6.xlarge at $1.60/h on-demand = $2.67. The bf16 BYVGEN run of this recipe billed 4,514 s; float32 adapters added no measurable time in step 1 (1,951 vs 1,950 s). The ceiling is the cap, not an estimate.
